eld.text: Lord Skitter, a rat king beneath Edgewall, meets Totentanz and promises him wicked powers in exchange for luring the townsfolk into the sewers, gifting him a magic pipe when he agrees to join him.
Totentanz leads Edgewall's citizens into the undercity and rats swarm the city, but the townsfolk steal the pipe and turn its magic on Skitter and Totentanz, who are devoured by the rats.
